input.summary: Household shelf audit at Yaba Market Store reported all 5 planogram SKUs (Sunlight 900g, Omo 1kg, Dettol Soap 110g, Lux Soap 80g, Close Up 140g) fully faced — 0 stock-outs, 100% compliance, no unknown products. However, audit confidence was only 0.35 with a low_conf flag, so the photo cannot be trusted. No inventory was pulled and no reorders were raised, since there is no evidence of any gap to fix and ordering on an untrustworthy image would risk overstocking. No telemetry was available and no equipment fault was indicated, so no technician was dispatched. A manager has been notified by WhatsApp to visually check the Household shelf and retake a clear photo.
